content: Wakutuuna Rahel akamata ande incia inda apalaahiri anaana to Yakub, akaura-uramo incia tee akana, kasiimpo apogau i Yakub, "Dhawuakaaku anaana; ande inda, taroakaakumo kumate."
Sumaimo Yakub aʼamaramo i Rahel onina, "Iaku sii buaka Aulataʼala mojoliko ubhawa-bhawa?"
Pogaumo Rahel, "Siimo Bilha, bhatuaku. Kawiakea mamudhaakana apalaahiri anana kabholosiku mamudhaakana iaku uka amembali kukoana alaloi incia."
Sumaimo, apasarakaakamo Bilha, bhatuana, i Yakub to apamembalia bhawinena. Yakub uka aporomuakamea.
Bilha abhawa-bhawamo, kasiimpo apalaahirimo samia anana umane.
Kasiimpomo Rahel apogaumo, "Aulataʼala apewau adili tee iaku, tee aperangoimea iemaniku tee adhawuakaakumo samia anana umane." Sababuna sumai incia asarongiakea anaana sumai Dan.
Kasiimpomo Bilha, bhawine bhatuana Rahel sumai, abhawa-bhawamo pendua tee apalaahirimo to Yakub anaana umane katutunina tumpe.
Apogaumo Rahel, "Iaku kuposaingimo mpuu tee akaku, tee iakumo mokanana." Sumaimo incia asarongiakea anana sumai Naftali.
Wakutuuna Lea akamatea ande incia indamo apalaahiri anana, abhawamo Zilpa, bhatuana, kasiimpomo apasarakaakamea i Yakub apamembalia bhawinena.
Kasiimpomo Zilpa, bhatuana Lea sumai, apalaahiri samia anana umane to Yakub.
Apogaumo Lea: "Kukodhawua mpuu!" Sababuna sumai incia asarongiakea anana sumai Gad
Zilpa, bhawine bhatuana Lea, apalaahirimo uka to Yakub samia anana umane katutunina tumpe.
Apogaumo Lea, "Iaku sii kumasanaamo! Tantumo manga bhawine asarongiakaaku kumasanaamo." Sababuna incia asarongiakea anana sumai Asyer.
Saangu wakutuu i bulaana timpuana gandum, Ruben alingka akambeli-mbeli. Incia apotibhaaka manga bhakena dudaim
i inawu, kasiimpo abhawamea i Lea, inana. Apogaumo Rahel i Lea, "Dhawuakaaku pia-pia angu bhakena dudaim pewauana o anamu sumai.

Alawanimo Lea i incia, "Indapo akawa buaka to ingkoo uala umaneku, sanampuu ingkoo upeelu ualamo uka bhakena dudaimna anaku?" Apogaumo Rahel, "Malapemo, taroakamo incia akole tee ingkoo malo sii to kabholosina bhakena dudaimna anamu sumai."

Tobhele eo, wakutuuna Yakub ambuli minaaka i inawu, alimbamo Lea apepagoa tee apogau, "Ingkoo tabeana usii i iaku, roonamo padhamo kusewako tee bhakena dudaimna anaku." Sababuna, akolemo Yakub tee incia i malo incia sumai.
Aulataʼala aperangoia Lea, sabutuna incia abhawa-bhawamo tee apalaahirimo anana umane lima miana to Yakub.
Apogaumo Lea, "Aulataʼala padhamo adhawuaku ponamboku, roonamo iaku padhamo kupasaraakaakea bhatuaku i umaneku." Sababuna, incia asarongiakea anana sumai Isakhar.
Kasiimpomo Lea abhawa-bhawamo uka tee apalaahirimo anana umane namamiana to Yakub.

Lea apogaumo, "Aulataʼala padhamo adhawuakaaku kadhawu momalape. Tantumo sii-sii umaneku bheaharagaangiaku, roonamo padhamo kupalaahiri nama mia anana umane to incia." Sababuna, incia asarongia anana sumai Zebulon.
Sapadhana incia sumai, incia apalaahirimo samia anana bhawine tee asarongiakea anana sumai Dina.
Kasiimpomo Aulataʼala audhani Rahel; Incia arangomea iemanina tee abungkaleakamea kadhumana.
Sabutuna abhawa-bhawamo Rahel tee apalaahirimo samia anana umane. Apogaumo incia, "Aulataʼala padhamo ahapusu kaeaku."
Sumaimo incia asarongiakea anana sumai Yusuf,
apoose apogau, "Sio-siomo KAWASANA OPU aranganiaku samiapo uka anana umane."
Nabii Yakub Apotibhaakamo Kadhambaaka
Sapadhana Rahel apalaahiri Yusuf, apogaumo Yakub i Laban, "Undaakaaku kulingka, mamudhaakana kumbuli i lipuku, i tampa laahiriaku.
Dhawuakaakumo manga bhawineku tee manga anaku, momembalina ponamboku i Pinoama, tee taroakaakumo kulingka. Pinoama umataua karomu tuaapa iaku padhamo kukarajaa to ingkoo."
Maka o Laban alawania, "Ande ingkoo upeelu ususuaka kaasimu to iaku, mbooremo iwe sii! Padhamo kumataua minaaka i pekilala, ande KAWASANA OPU abarakatiaku rampaakanamo ingkoo."
Pogauna uka, "Totapuakea saopea ponambomu, iaku bhekudhawuakako."
Alawanimo Yakub i incia, "Ingkoo samia umataua tuaapa kukarajaa to ingkoo, tee tuaapa kadhaangiana kadhambaakamu ijaganiku,

sababuna saidhemea kabharina pewauamu wakutuuna indapo kuumba, maka sii-sii ajulumo kabharina. KAWASANA OPU padhamo abarakati Pinoama kangengena kukarajaa iwe sii. Sii-sii, naepia kumembali kukarajaa to manga mia i bhanuaku karoku?"

Aabhamo Laban, "Opea tabeana idhawuakaku i ingkoo?" Alawanimo Yakub, "Pinoama, bholimo udhawuakaaku opeopea. Iaku sadhaadhaana kudhambaaka bhembe dumbamu tee kujagania, ande uundaakea hali incia sii to iaku:

Eo sii, bhekudhala kulaloi bhari-bharia bhembe dumbana Pinoama tee kugaatia minaaka iwe sumai sambaa-sambaa anana dumba mokotanda-tandana tee mokobhelombana; sambaa-sambaa anana dumba momaetana tee sambaa-sambaa bhembe mokobhelombana tee mokotanda-tandana. Siitumo bhemomembalina ponamboku.

Tee ande mboo sumai, naile naipua Pinoama bheumembali uparikisaaia kajujuruku i nuncana halina ponamboku. Sumaimo iaku tangkanamo bhekuala momaetana tee mokowarawaranaana. Ande dhaangia binata inda mboo sumai, maʼanana padhamo kumanakoa, tee Pinoama bheumataua."
Alawanimo Laban, "Umbe, mboomo ipogauakamu itu."

Maka incia inda aose pojanjiana tee Yakub i saao. Laban alingka agaatia i eo incia sumai manga bhembe umane mokobhelombana tee mokotanda-tandana, bhari-bharia bhembe bhawine mokobhelombana tee mokotanda-tandana, siitumo bhari-bharia mokotandana maputi i badana, tee bhari-bharia dumba momaetana, kasiimpo apasaraakea bhari-bharia sumai i limana manga anana umanena.

Kasiimpomo Laban apapogaa manga kadhambaakana sumai talu eo karidhona lingkaana minaaka i Yakub, sainamo Yakub ajagani manga bhembe dumbana Laban mosagaanana, sumaimo inda mokowarawaranaana tee momaputina.
Kasiimpomo, Yakub aalamo manga raha maijo minaaka i puuna hawar, puuna badam, tee puuna berangan.
Akulasimea sagaa kulina sampe akobhelomba maputi i manga raha sumai.
Incia adhikaia manga raha ikulasina sumai i aroana manga bhembe dumba sumai, i nuncana dhingkanana uwe isumpuna, roonamo manga binata sumai sadia akawi ande bheasumpu.
Sumaimo, manga bhembe dumba sumai akawi i aroana manga raha mokobhelombana maputi sumai, sabutuna alaahirimo manga anana mokotanda-tandana tee mokobhelombana.

Kasiimpomo Yakub agaatimea manga dumba bhemokawina sumai apapoaroa manga bhembe dumbana Laban momaetana tee mokobhelombana. Tee akala mboo sumai, Yakub arangani kabharina kadhambaakana karona tee agaatia minaaka i kadhambaakana Laban.

Jadi, sadia ande bheakawi manga bhembe dumba momakaana, Yakub adhikamea manga raha sumai i nuncana dhingkanana uwe isumpuna i aroana bhembe dumba sumai, mamudhaakana manga incia akawi amakasu i manga raha sumai.

Maka ande aumba saguluma bhembe dumba momalute, incia inda adhika manga raha sumai i aroana. Tee mboo sumai, manga kadhambaaka momalute amembali pewauana Laban, sainamo kadhambaaka momakaana amembali pewauana Yakub.
Sabutuna, ahandamo ajulu karangkaeana Yakub. Incia abhari gulumana bhembe dumbana, unta, tee keledai, tee uka bhatuana umane tee bhawine.

Naftali: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani akomaʼana "poewangi."
Gad: Saro incia sii i nuncana pogau Ibrani akomaʼana "kodhawua."
Asyer: Saro incia sii i nuncana pogau Ibrani akomaʼana "amasanaa."
dudaim: Penembula incia sii atoabhi tee atoparacaea amembali lancau mopasuburuna kadhuma.
Isakhar: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼana "bhatua isewa" atawa "dhaangia tee ponambona".
Zebulon: Saro incia sii atorango mboomo pogauna Ibrani akomaʼanana "haragaangi" atawa "kadhawu."
Yusuf: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "incia mopailaia" atawa "incia apekadhawumo uka".
puuna hawar, puuna badam, tee puuna berangan: Talu giuna puuna kau sii akokau maputi mpuu.
